changelog:
🌍 Public link: Settings → Server can put this dashboard and the API on a public HTTPS link through Tailscale Funnel, with a free Tailscale account and no port to open. The first time, the server downloads its Tailscale helper (about 8 MB) for this version and checks it against a checksum built into the proxy.
🪜 The setup shows as steps (Download, Connect, Sign in, Funnel, Live), with the download's size and progress and a button for each step at Tailscale. The link stays the same after a restart.
🔒 Through the link, API calls always need an API key and the first-run password is never shown. The card warns while two-factor sign-in is off or no API key exists.
🎨 Notices have a new look: a light fill in their colour with a solid button, easier to read in the dark theme.
🔗 A long link in a copy field wraps at its dots instead of inside a name.
